description: Modules that are a scientific rig rather than a runtime path. Each is exempt from the test-only reachability count and must state why. Read by tools/lint_module_reachability.py. A module listed here may not be cited as evidence that the runtime does something.

modules.core.learning.procedure_induction: Enumerative procedure synthesis for the compiler-free acquisition experiment. Run deliberately by tests and by tools; nothing in the response path calls it, and wiring it in to satisfy a counter would be worse than leaving it out.
modules.core.learning.compiler_free_experiment: The held-out-family experiment with its lesion and null arms. An experiment, not a capability: its result is a verdict about Aura, not a behaviour of Aura.
modules.core.learning.induced_neural_procedure: Experimental bridge from family-blind induced programs into qualified semantic neural tissue; it remains outside serving until powered transfer and resident-decode controls pass.
modules.core.learning.semantic_computation_loop: G03's grounded semantic computation loop: one entry from a source-grounded candidate union through scoped computation, observation, recomputation and recipe retention. Measured on development cohorts by tests/test_semantic_mixed_computation_loop.py; docs/evidence/G03_MIXED_COMPUTATION_ENTRY_2026-09-30.md states it is not installed as a serving policy, and G03 is open.
modules.core.reasoning.computational_models: The reviewed model cells (physics, chemistry, kinetics) the G03 computation loop formulates against, each with premises, units and a cited reference. Reached through the experimental computation loop and its tests; no runtime path formulates with it yet.
modules.core.reasoning.scoped_logical_computatio: Derives scoped facts through the existing proof kernel for the G03 computation loop's model guards. Part of the same experiment; no runtime caller until G03's computation path is joined to reasoning.
modules.core.learning.semantic_binding_capacity: Exact reduced-rank diagnostics for a declared linear surrogate of G03's binding, as its own docstring says: a bound on that surrogate and those observations, not on Aura's decoder. Measured by tests/test_semantic_binding_capacity.py; nothing in the runtime calls it.
modules.core.learning.semantic_grounded_chart_br: Feeds observed relation evidence into G03's compositional chart decoding. Measured by tests/test_semantic_grounded_chart_bridge.py and docs/evidence/G03_BINDING_BUILD_REGISTER_2026-09-30.md; a6d704c37 keeps G03 unqualified, so no serving path decodes through it.
modules.core.learning.semantic_symbol_inquiry: Revises caller-proposed symbol meanings from source-identified demonstrations, for G03's learned-language work. Reached through the semasiographic experiment and its tests; no runtime caller while G03 is open.
